about: Venue facts shared by research-paper-plan and research-rebuttal. One row per venue; every row carries the date its facts were last checked against the listed sources. Print, diff, and check rows with scripts/venue_table.py. Fields that a source does not state are null; never fill them by analogy with another year or venue.

venues.response_format: Default rebuttal form: Markdown text, 2500 characters; default comment form: Markdown text, 5000 characters
venues.revision_mechanics: OpenReview supports one rebuttal per paper, one per review, or several per paper
venues.key_constraints: Actual conferences often override these defaults

venues.response_format: Optional 1-page PDF rebuttal
venues.revision_mechanics: No iterative discussion noted in author guide
venues.key_constraints: Must remain anonymous; no external links; should not add unrequested new results or major new material

venues.response_format: Optional 1-page PDF rebuttal
venues.revision_mechanics: No iterative discussion noted in author guide
venues.key_constraints: Must remain anonymous; no external links; can send confidential comment to AC; should not add unrequested new results or major new material

venues.response_format: Optional 1-page PDF rebuttal in ECCV rebuttal template
venues.revision_mechanics: No iterative author-reviewer exchange described on submission policy page
venues.key_constraints: No external links in submission, supplement, or rebuttal when they expand content; overlength or altered-format rebuttals will not be reviewed

venues.response_format: OpenReview discussion plus revised PDF; no single 1-page rebuttal rule
venues.revision_mechanics: Authors can respond and revise from 2025-11-11 to 2025-12-03

venues.response_format: One official response per review, 5000 characters each

venues.response_format: Three rounds in OpenReview-style discussion, each limited to 5000 characters

venues.key_constraints: Authors are encouraged to address major misunderstandings, not every minor point; responses must stay anonymous and avoid non-anonymized or shortened URLs; AC-only comments are possible through reader-restricted notes rather than a public author artifact

venues.response_format: Text-only author-reviewer discussion; no manuscript revision allowed during discussion

venues.key_constraints: Text-only discussion; updated manuscript not allowed until acceptance; authors may post links during discussion but anonymity still applies and reviewers are not obliged to click

venues.response_format: Text-only author rebuttal and author-reviewer discussion; no manuscript revision allowed during discussion
venues.revision_mechanics: Author rebuttal period 2025-11-21 to 2025-11-30, then author-reviewer discussion 2025-12-01 to 2025-12-08
venues.key_constraints: Text-only discussion; no manuscript revision allowed until acceptance; external links are not allowed during discussion in 2026 FAQ
